ability_text: Immortal: Gain 1 Elder Sign when Cthulhu awakens
code_pattern: Check f.has(Immortal) in AwakenedAction(self, Cthulhu, r, cost) handler, call self.takeES(1)

ability_text: Devour: Before battle, eliminate enemy cultist to add Kill result
code_pattern: Pre-battle menu option added in Battle.scala prebattle() at line ~508, checks f.has(Devour) && vulnerable units exist, handler eliminates unit and adds Kill to rolls
location: Battle.scala prebattle() lines ~508-509; handler in Battle.scala ~900+

ability_text: Absorb: Before battle, add Absorbed marker to Shoggoth (counts as 3-strength unit)
code_pattern: Pre-battle menu at Battle.scala ~514, handler adds Absorbed marker via unit.add(Absorbed); strength calculation in FactionGC.strength() counts Absorbed markers as +3

ability_text: Regenerate: After battle, pay 1 Power per Pain to heal
code_pattern: Post-battle phase handler in Battle.scala checks f.can(Regenerate), offers healing actions, deducts power and clears Pain markers

ability_text: Devolve: Eliminate Acolyte to summon Deep One
code_pattern: Main-action menu DevolveMainAction, handler eliminates Acolyte via game.eliminate(c), then f.place(DeepOne, r)

ability_text: Dreams: Pay 2 Power to replace enemy Acolyte with own Acolyte
code_pattern: Main-action menu DreamsMainAction, handler eliminates enemy unit via game.eliminate(u), then e.place(Acolyte, r)

ability_text: Submerge: Move Cthulhu and court to off-map Deep region; later unsubmerge anywhere
code_pattern: SubmergeMainAction moves units to GC.deep via u.region = GC.deep; UnsubmergeAction moves back via u.region = r (target region)

ability_text: Fertility Cult: Always has +6 Cultists in Pool
code_pattern: Not coded as discount; Pool capacity is checked via faction.pool(Acolyte) calls which include virtual cultists
location: Implicit in pool checks throughout codebase

ability_text: The Thousand Young: Monsters cost 1 less if Shub-Niggurath in play
code_pattern: Override summonCost() in FactionBG: case Ghoul | Fungi | DarkYoung if f.can(ThousandYoung) && f.has(ShubNiggurath) => u.cost - 1

ability_text: Shub-Niggurath combat = gates + cultists + (Dark Young * Red Sign multiplier)
code_pattern: strength() method calculates: f.gates.num + f.cultists.num + f.all(DarkYoung).num * f.can(RedSign).??(1)

ability_text: Frenzy: Acolytes add 1 combat strength each
code_pattern: strength() adds: units(Acolyte).num * f.can(Frenzy).??(1)

ability_text: Necrophagy: Gain 1 Power per enemy unit killed in battle
code_pattern: Post-battle handler in Battle.scala checks f.can(Necrophagy), counts killed enemy units, adds power via f.power += count

ability_text: Avatar: Replace enemy Monster with own Monster
code_pattern: AvatarAction eliminates enemy unit via game.eliminate(u), then places own monster f.place(replacementClass, r)

ability_text: Blood Sacrifice: Doom phase, eliminate Cultist for 1 Power
code_pattern: BloodSacrificeAction handler eliminates cultist via game.eliminate(u), adds f.power += 1

ability_text: Ghroth: Pay X Power, enemies negotiate Cultist elimination or pay tribute
code_pattern: GhrothAction manages offer collection via GhrothAskAction for each enemy, then GhrothEliminateAction distributes eliminations or power
location: GhrothAction through GhrothEliminateAction handlers in BGExpansion.perform

ability_text: The Harbinger: At battle start, add Kills equal to enemy Cultists
code_pattern: Battle.scala prebattle checks f.has(Harbinger) && f.forces(Nyarlathotep).any, adds Kill results to attacker.kills

ability_text: Flight: Move to any area regardless of adjacency
code_pattern: Override canMoveTo() or movement validation to allow non-adjacent moves when f.has(Flight)

ability_text: Abduct: Before battle, capture enemy unit
code_pattern: Pre-battle menu AbductPreBattleAction at Battle.scala ~520, handler captures unit via game.capture(unit)

ability_text: Seek and Destroy: Move Hunting Horrors into battle from anywhere
code_pattern: Pre-battle menu SeekAndDestroyPreBattleAction at Battle.scala ~526-527, handler moves units into battle arena

ability_text: Invisibility: Mark Flying Polyps as immune to Kill/Pain assignment

ability_text: Madness: After battle, assign own Pains to enemy units

ability_text: Writhe: Roll dice = Power; Kills eliminate own units (Acolytes become Desiccated), Pains relocate own units

ability_text: Augury: During Writhe, replace Misses with Kills
code_pattern: FBWritheAuguryReplaceAction modifies rolls array, replacing Miss with Kill up to N times

ability_text: Infernal Pact: Flip faceup spellbooks to reduce costs by 1 each

ability_text: Ghatanothoa combat = owner's current Power
code_pattern: strength() returns: units(Ghatanothoa).not(Zeroed).num * f.power

ability_text: Revenant of K'Naa combat = flat 3
code_pattern: strength() returns: units(RevenantOfKnaa).not(Zeroed).num * 3

ability_text: Cyclopean Gaze: After opponent acts/battles, pain enemy units in areas with Revenants/Ghatanothoa

ability_text: Carnage: After battle, flip enemy spellbook facedown
code_pattern: Post-battle handler FBCarnagePostBattleAction offers enemy spellbook targeting, sets sb.faceDown = true

ability_text: Devil's Mark: Place Crater building, destroys any non-Yog gate in region

ability_text: The Beyond One: Capture enemy Cultists onto gates instead of prison

ability_text: The Key and the Gate: Gates cost 0 if at enemy gate
code_pattern: Override gateCost() or gate placement cost check: if enemy gate in region && f.has(KeyAndGate) then cost = 0

ability_text: They Break Through: Monsters cost 1 less at gates
code_pattern: Override summonCost(): if r has gate && f.can(TheyBreakThrough) then reduce cost by 1

ability_text: The Million Favored Ones: +1 combat per Hunting Horror at gates
code_pattern: strength() adds conditional bonus: units at gates with f.can(MillionFavoredOnes) get +1

ability_text: Death from Below: Enemy units cannot Move

ability_text: Burrow: Move between any two areas (Lovecraft rulebook)

ability_text: Energy Nexus: Interrupt any battle with Wizard present to take full turn

ability_text: Demand Sacrifice: Before battle, force enemy to eliminate own Cultist

ability_text: Hierophants: Can recruit High Priests instead of Acolytes
